ruleName: Ball Lifted or Deliberately Touched by Player or Causes It to Move
title: Practice Swing Moves Your Ball
question: Your ball lies on the fairway. Before playing your shot, you take a practice swing and accidentally take a divot. The divot flies forward, hits your ball and causes it to move. What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: There is no penalty because you did not touch the ball with your club.
There is no penalty. Play the ball from its new position.
You receive a one-stroke penalty because your actions caused the ball to move. You must replace the ball on its original spot.

explanation: Although the club did not touch the ball, your practice swing caused the divot to move the ball. As your action is responsible for the ball's movement, you receive a one-stroke penalty and must replace the ball on its original spot before making your next stroke. This is covered under Rule 9.4.
